text: Remember our study of Nehemiah, where Eric shared a lot of the insights from this book. And now we get to see people around the world be blessed and encouraged by this incredible resource. Please join me in praying for everyone who will receive a copy. Heavenly Father, we pray for every single person that receives the copy of this book, that they would be impacted, that they would be inspired and encouraged to lead the way in which you led Nehemiah to do so. Bless.
